requirements.requirement: Production P1 execution is driven by the frozen exact 116-metric Catalog rather than a representative allow-list.
requirements.gap: Production worker currently selects five representative P1-AIR metrics.

requirements.requirement: Production P1 preserves exact Catalog subject membership: 40 AIRCRAFT, 72 MISSION_SYSTEM_INSTANCE, 4 TARGET_PAIR.
requirements.gap: Production publication path currently materializes the AIRCRAFT representative lane only.

requirements.requirement: All six governed source families have explicit production adapter boundaries and fail-closed unsupported-profile behavior.
requirements.gap: Only FLIGHT has a registered production adapter and durable import path.

requirements.requirement: Production P1 binds governed Context, Episode, Stage, World and event/relation prerequisites before Metric execution.
requirements.gap: Qualified Episode/Stage/World projectors exist, but production P1 uses a reduced world with no Stage sequence.

requirements.requirement: Normal production workflows create all P2-P6 prerequisite products without qualification seed helpers.
requirements.gap: Installed C5 E2E seeds P3-P6 prerequisite products before invoking production jobs.

requirements.requirement: Training assessment executes adopted sufficiency, critical-gate, competency and qualification semantics while preserving immutable evidence/review revisions.
requirements.gap: P4/P5 provide evidence/revision/approval substrate; P5 explicitly remains evidence-only when no numeric aggregation authority is adopted.

requirements.requirement: Upper product surfaces cover Event/Relation/root-cause, longitudinal Human/Team, Course/Unit, Training Plugin, Joint/LVC gateway, media/bookmark/playlist and complete linked debrief UX.
